name: swim_h2o_fresh
description: Placed water, held out (physics.md 6.6; replaces swim_h2o_drops, retired by the owner 2026-10-09: its capture placed the player while it still swam from the previous drop): drops 5 units above the Old World Blues interior NVDLC03SLH2OINT's XCLW (-232), 96 above its placed water (NVDLC03CleanWater2048x2048, reference 0x03014467, scale 2, surface -328), each after a fresh coc to the cell so the player is not swimming. The five points of the retired scenario (floors 456-496 and 40 below the placed surface, and one beside the catwalk stairs), plus two over floors 122 and 130 below the surface (past the 100-unit swimming depth) and two over floors 75 and 79 below it (short of it). Points from vertical rays of `fnvtool phys cell --cell NVDLC03SLH2OINT` (2026-10-09).
